 Print Gandhinagar : Gujarat govt has corrected an error in its notification announcing bank holidays for 2027, clarifying that the public holiday for Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Jayanti will be observed on Wednesday, April 14, 2027. The earlier notification had incorrectly mentioned the date as April 14, 2026. The general administration department has issued a revised notification stating that April 14, 2027, will be observed as a bank holiday.
